name: CPCA
summary: (+)-CPCA (also known as nocaine, 3α-carbomethoxy-4β-(4-chlorophenyl)-N-methylpiperidine, or CTDP 31,446) is a stimulant drug similar in structure to pethidine (an opioid that possesses NDRI actions) and to RTI-31, but nocaine lacks the two-carbon bridge of RTI-31's tropane skeleton. This compound was first developed as a substitute agent for cocaine.
